news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback aligning with Abivax's planned NDA submission strategy and content for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, keeping the company on track to file its first NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax added four commercial leaders in marketing, patient services, sales and market access, drawn from Amgen, Takeda, AbbVie, Eli Lilly and Abbott with experience on blockbusters like Entyvio and Humira, as it builds out its team for a potential U.S. launch of obefazimod.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley raises Abivax price target to $180 from $132
news.summary: Morgan Stanley sharply raised its price target on Abivax, joining a wave of analyst upgrades (Jefferies to Buy/$158, Piper Sandler to $175) following the resolution of the earlier cancer-signal safety scare and the large capital raise.

news.headline: Abivax's $920M cash haul lets it prepare for a solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel told CNBC that the freshly closed $920 million financing gives Abivax the option to commercialize obefazimod independently in the U.S. rather than needing an acquisition, even as takeover speculation (including reported Eli Lilly interest) continues.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Full Exercise of Underwriters' Option, Bringing Gross Proceeds of Offering to $920M
news.summary: Underwriters fully exercised their option to buy an additional 960,000 ADSs, lifting total gross proceeds of Abivax's public offering to about $920 million (roughly $874M net), funds earmarked for U.S. commercialization and IBD R&D.

news.headline: Abivax Prices Highly Oversubscribed and Upsized $800M Public Offering of ADSs at $125.00 per ADS
news.summary: Abivax priced an upsized, oversubscribed offering of 6.4 million ADSs at $125 each, raising roughly $800M (before the underwriters' option), extending its cash runway into Q4 2029 to fund the obefazimod launch.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's scheduled half-year 2026 financial results and corporate/pipeline update, per its published financial calendar.

catalysts.label: Obefazimod NDA submission to FDA (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance, reaffirmed after the positive July 30, 2026 pre-NDA FDA meeting, is to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC by end of 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Next scheduled quarterly results/business update on Abivax's financial calendar.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA action on obefazimod NDA / U.S. launch
catalysts.detail: Assuming a Q4 2026 filing and standard review timeline, an FDA decision (and possible U.S. launch) would likely land in 2027; exact PDUFA date not yet set since the NDA has not been filed.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease induction data
catalysts.detail: 12-week induction readout for obefazimod in Crohn's disease; company timing guidance has varied across disclosures (some citing late 2026, others mid-2027), so timing is not firmly locked.

pulse: Abivax had a strong run through July 2026 — a positive pre-NDA FDA meeting, a fully-subscribed $920M raise, new commercial leadership hires, and a string of analyst price-target hikes (Morgan Stanley to $180, Jefferies to $158) — that pushed ADSs above $130 and comfortably above the $120 strike, before shares pulled back into the roughly $90-105 range in mid-August on apparent profit-taking/dilution digestion with no new negative catalyst identified. The setup into H1 2026 results (Sept 21) and the planned Q4 2026 NDA filing remains fundamentally intact, with persistent M&A speculation (reported Eli Lilly interest) an added source of optionality. For the March 2027 $120 call, the stock is currently back near/below strike after having pierced well above it in late July, making the September earnings print and NDA-filing progress the key near-term drivers of whether shares reclaim and hold above $120 ahead of expiry.
